title: Anatomy of the Truffle Flow
headline: Built layer by layer.
concept: Exploded slow-build reel — each layer drops in, reassembles into the hero, then the cut-in-half money shot with steam. Every ingredient labelled.
shotFlow: 2–6s layers stack in slow-mo, labels appear
caption: Some burgers are assembled. This one is engineered. You'll taste every layer.
artDirection: Exploded build on black · ingredient labels · mozzarella pull as hero frame

title: Glove Up
headline: You've been eating burgers wrong.
sub: Glove up. Open. Sauce. Bite. Share.
concept: Hands-only POV of the full ritual, each step numbered on screen. Turns delivery into theatre.
caption: Not just a burger. A ritual. Welcome to the Salsa Club.
artDirection: Hands-only POV · dark surface · numbered step titles · brand box in frame

title: Dip Now
headline: Dip now.
concept: Full-bleed single-imperative typographic drop. The copy is the creative.
caption: No caption needed. Dip now.
artDirection: Type does 100% of the work · brand red + black · zero clutter

title: First Order 20 Off
headline: First order = 20% off.
concept: A clean, scannable promo card — one offer, one code, one CTA.
caption: New here? Your first dip is 20% off. Code SALSA1 on Grab & LINE MAN.
artDirection: One message, one code, one CTA · big legible type · no competing elements
